easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
description:
Cast PuPu UFO by paying {2}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the PuPu UFO spell three times.
Resolve the first PuPu UFO copy.
Activate the PuPu UFO's first ability by tapping it, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.
